name: Naruto Trainer
source: You take on the role of a young ninja whose village was recently attacked. Sent to the Hidden Leaf Village to continue your training, you must hone your skills, uncover the truth about your family's fate, and seek out those responsible for the destruction of your home.
translation: 你扮演一名年轻忍者的角色，他的村庄最近遭到袭击。被送往木叶村继续训练，你必须磨练自己的技能，揭开家人命运的真相，并找出那些破坏你家园的人。
